Text: Traditional software testing is not enough for agents.

You need a full testing pyramid that goes from unit checks all the way to continuous production evaluation.

Here’s the complete Agent Testing Pyramid & Strategies:

**Agent Testing Pyramid & Strategies**

4 key layers:
1. Unit & Component Tests
2. Integration Tests
3. Evaluation & Scenario Tests
4. Production Monitoring & Shadow Tests

Core principle: Test the behavior, not just the code. Agents require continuous evaluation, not one-time tests.

Save this. It’s the testing foundation every production agent team needs.
